name: Mist
summary: Mist is an escort quest in the shaded boughs of Teldrassil. After discovering a wounded gray sabercat abandoned deep in the woods, travelers must shepherd her safely back to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at a nearby moon well.

sections.title: A Wounded Companion
sections.body: Tucked away amid the wild undergrowth of Teldrassil lies Mist, a distinctive gray sabercat marked by severe, slashing lacerations across her back and belly. Rather than acting as a feral beast of the wilds, Mist exhibits remarkable calm and bright intelligence in her blue eyes, immediately looking to friendly travelers for guidance and protection.

sections.title: The Price of Ambush
sections.body: Mist is the beloved companion of Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. While patrolling the great boughs near the Oracle Tree, Arynia was caught off guard by foul witches who ambushed the pair and separated them. Believing her loyal pet had met a bloody end, Arynia withdrew in grief to the tranquility of a local moon well, where she desperately hoped against hope for Mist's survival.

faq.answer: Mist is a loyal gray sabercat companion belonging to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. She is found injured in the forests of Teldrassil after being separated from her master during a violent ambush.
Mist and her master were ambushed by local witches lurking within the woods of Teldrassil. The attackers managed to separate the pair and inflicted deep lacerations across the cat's back and stomach.
Mist needs to be brought safely to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak, who is stationed beside the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf Sentinel and Mist's companion. She is stationed at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.

faq.q: Why are night elf Sentinels bonded with sabercats?
faq.answer: Night elf Sentinels have fought alongside the great cats of Kalimdor for millennia, relying on them as fierce partners in skirmishes, scouts in the shadowy boughs, and trusted lifelong companions.

faq.q: Where is the Oracle Tree in relation to this rescue?
faq.answer: The Oracle Tree sits in northwestern Teldrassil, with a nearby moon well providing holy waters where Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak tends to her duties.

angles.text: The bond between Sentinel and sabercat is a cornerstone of night elf warfare and forest lore; rescuing Mist upholds that ancient, sacred companionship.
Any beastmaster will recognize the fierce devotion and intelligent gaze in Mist's eyes, making her safe return to her partner a matter of professional pride.
Aiding the Sentinels in Teldrassil cements vital goodwill between the fledgling Alliance and the kaldorei defenders of the world tree.
